say:8:1523503004:0.text: Hold on! He's taken the herbalist hostage! Don't be rash!

say:9:1523503005:1.text: Aurelin's desperate now... We can't let him hurt the herbalist!

say:9:1523503005:1.female: Aurelin's desperate now... We can't let him hurt the herbalist!

say:10:1523503006:1.text: I'll try to <style="highlight">stall him</style>, then we can bide our time to rescue her.
say:10:1523503006:1.male: I'll try to <style="highlight">stall him</style>, then we can bide our time to rescue her.
say:10:1523503006:1.female: I'll try to <style="highlight">stall him</style>, then we can bide our time to rescue her.

say:12:1523503007:1.text: Don't come any closer, or I'll end her!
say:12:1523503007:1.source_cn: 都不许动！你们敢上前一步，我就立刻杀了她！

say:13:1523503008:0.text: Aurelin, it's over—you have no more soldiers left.
say:13:1523503008:0.source_cn: 奥勒留，你手下的士兵已经尽数倒下，你谋逆夺权的计划已经...

say:14:1523503009:1.text: Surrender now, instead of harming more innocent lives. The Regulus might grant you clemency for the sake of your past service.
say:14:1523503009:1.source_cn: 停止反抗，别再让你手上沾上无辜者的鲜血。看在你过往的贡...

say:15:1523503010:1.text: This lady's here to work on the bitter corn, right? I'm not entirely clueless, you know!
say:15:1523503010:1.source_cn: 哈，别以为我不知道！这人是你们找来研究苦苞穗的，对吧？

say:16:1523503011:1.text: I've failed, and I'll make sure all of you pay for it!
say:16:1523503011:1.source_cn: 我失败了，你们也别想好过！

choice_prompt:17:1523503011.text: I've failed, and I'll make sure all of you pay for it!
choice_prompt:17:1523503011.source_cn: 我失败了，你们也别想好过！

say:18:1523503012:1.text: What are you talking about? I'm the one who can save Halia!
say:18:1523503012:1.source_cn: 什么希望！呼临的希望在我身上！
say:18:1523503012:1.male: What are you talking about? I'm the one who can save Halia!
say:18:1523503012:1.female: What are you talking about? I'm the one who can save Halia!

say:19:1523503014:1.text: Aurelin... I can't believe you're still not giving up.

say:20:1523503015:0.text: Does power really matter more to you than Halia's future?!
say:20:1523503015:0.source_cn: 难道你真要为了领主之位，毁掉呼临的未来吗？！

say:21:1523503016:1.text: I'm the only one who can lead Halia to a prosperous future!
say:21:1523503016:1.source_cn: 只有我上位，呼临才有未来！

say:22:1523503017:0.text: I've given my all as Herennus' right-hand man, and I didn't mind when he chose to pass his title to a child...
say:22:1523503017:0.source_cn: 我尽心尽力地辅佐赫伦尼，就算是他让阿邦德一个小孩上位我...

say:23:1523503018:0.text: I've done so much for Halia, but all of you kept dismissing my ideas!
say:23:1523503018:0.source_cn: 我为呼临城付出了那么多！是你们一直在否定我的计策！

say:24:1523503019:0.text: You all opposed my plan to attack the Wildborn until Halia was backed into a corner.
say:24:1523503019:0.source_cn: 我献计攻打雅库伯尔，你们犹豫不决……非要等到走投无路，...

say:25:1523503020:0.text: If you had taken my advice sooner, we could have already subdued the Wildborn!
say:25:1523503020:0.source_cn: 要是早听我的，早日开战，雅库伯尔早成了我们的囊中之物！

say:26:1523503021:0.text: I'm the better person to lead Halia!
say:26:1523503021:0.source_cn: 所以——呼临城的领主之位，应该属于我！

say:30:1523503023:1.text: You're doing all this for yourself, not Halia!
say:30:1523503023:1.source_cn: 你根本不是为了呼临……你是为了你自己！

say:31:1523503024:1.text: You know nothing, you naive little brat!

say:32:1523503025:1.text: You don't care about the people at all. All that matters to you is power.
say:32:1523503025:1.source_cn: 你口口声声说你在乎呼临，但实际上，你只在乎呼临赋予你的...

say:33:1523503026:1.text: Can you truly see what the people are enduring? Famine, war, and floods.
say:33:1523503026:1.source_cn: 你难道不知道，呼临在饥荒、战争和洪灾中遭受的苦难？

say:34:1523503027:0.text: Do you know how many of them have fainted from hunger, lost their loved ones, and been left homeless after the floods?
say:34:1523503027:0.source_cn: 多少人在饥荒中饿到昏倒……多少人失去亲人，又有多少人在...

say:35:1523503028:1.text: What they really long for is a peaceful life—enough food to eat and clothes to wear. War is the last thing they want!
say:35:1523503028:1.source_cn: 呼临人真正想要的是和平的生活，是吃饱穿暖！才不是战争！

say:36:1523503029:1.text: While I see their sufferings, you don't.
say:36:1523503029:1.source_cn: 我看到了呼临人的苦难……但你没有。

cinematic_dialogue:40:1523504001:.text: You never truly care about Halia!

cinematic_dialogue:40:1523504002:.text: You don't know anything, you little brat!
